calculation_handling.description: An adult education school is permitted in a building used as, or originally constructed as, a private or public school.
calculation_handling.gaps: Adult education use and original construction are not held.

calculation_handling.description: An adult education school is permitted only if funded by the Provincial or Federal government for one of the listed adult education programs.
calculation_handling.gaps: Funding status is not a lot or scenario input.

units.disclosure: The government funding condition for adult education schools is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A day nursery in a school building is permitted if it is on the first storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: Which storey a use occupies is not a model target.

units.disclosure: The rule that a day nursery in a school building be on the first storey is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A day nursery in a school building is permitted if its interior floor area is no more than 40% of the interior floor area of the first storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: First-storey interior floor area is not held.

units.disclosure: The 40% first-storey interior floor area cap on a day nursery in a school building is not evaluated.

150.48.20.1(1).explanation: An adult education school is permitted in a building used as, or originally built as, a private or public school, if it is funded by the Provincial or Federal government for one of the listed adult education programs.

150.48.20.1(2).explanation: A day nursery is permitted in a building used as, or originally built as, a private or public school if it is on the first storey and uses no more than 40% of the interior floor area of the first storey.
